entries.en: The soprano's control of quiet passages seemed unmatchable.
entries.zh: 这位女高音对轻声乐段的掌控似乎无人能及。

entries.en: We stored the spare blankets in the rearmost compartment.
entries.zh: 我们把备用毯子放在最后面的隔间里。

entries.en: I was at a loss when the instructions suddenly changed.
entries.zh: 说明突然改变时，我不知所措。

entries.en: We waited forever and a day for the replacement part.
entries.zh: 我们等那个替换零件等了很久很久。

entries.en: You need a key to get into the storage room.
entries.zh: 你需要钥匙才能进入储藏室。

entries.en: Her memoir includes a chapter about the change of life.
entries.zh: 她的回忆录中有一章谈到绝经期。

entries.en: The spare cups are out of reach on that shelf.
entries.zh: 备用杯子放在那个架子上，伸手够不着。

entries.en: Try to get hold of the handle with both hands.
entries.zh: 试着用双手抓住把手。

entries.en: The commander discussed the strategical importance of the mountain pass.
entries.zh: 指挥官讨论了这个山口的战略重要性。

entries.en: The editor cut the folderol and kept the useful details.
entries.zh: 编辑删掉了废话，保留了有用的细节。

entries.zh: 那个幼儿一再把勺子扔到地上。

entries.en: Please think about the travel costs before accepting.
entries.zh: 接受之前，请考虑一下交通费用。

entries.en: The constitution describes the duties of the head of state.
entries.zh: 宪法规定了国家元首的职责。

entries.en: Dad will have a fit when he sees the muddy carpet.
entries.zh: 爸爸看到满是泥的地毯时会大发脾气。

entries.en: We had to get out before the gates closed.
entries.zh: 我们必须在大门关闭前出去。

entries.en: The historian examined attitudes toward spinsterhood in nineteenth-century villages.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了十九世纪村庄对未婚妇女身份的态度。

entries.en: The demonstration used a flameproof cover over the workbench.
entries.zh: 演示时，工作台上铺了一层防火罩布。

entries.en: Keep the upstroke light when practicing this letter.
entries.zh: 练习这个字母时，向上的一笔要轻。

entries.en: Melting ice provides a familiar example of a change of state.
entries.zh: 冰的融化是一个常见的物态变化实例。

entries.en: The palmist pointed to the line of life on his palm.
entries.zh: 看手相的人指着他手掌上的生命线。

entries.en: The seedlings need shade for a short period of time.
entries.zh: 幼苗需要遮阴一小段时间。

entries.en: They lived as man and wife in a cottage by the river.
entries.zh: 他们作为夫妻，住在河边的一间小屋里。

entries.en: A man of action, he grabbed a broom before discussing the mess.
entries.zh: 他是个注重行动的人，没讨论那片狼藉就先拿起了扫帚。

entries.en: What led you into this particular line of work?
entries.zh: 是什么使你进入了这个行业？

entries.en: She described her husband as a patient helpmeet in every venture.
entries.zh: 她说丈夫在每次尝试中都是耐心相助的良伴。

entries.en: He finally acknowledged the wrongfulness of concealing the evidence.
entries.zh: 他终于承认隐瞒证据是不正当的。

entries.en: The exhibition explained the historical training of a castrato.
entries.zh: 展览介绍了历史上阉人歌手的训练情况。

entries.en: May I keep on my coat during the rehearsal?
entries.zh: 彩排时我可以不脱外套吗？

entries.en: I agree to that extent, but our conclusions still differ.
entries.zh: 在那个程度上我同意，但我们的结论仍然不同。

entries.en: The festival's success depends to a great extent on volunteers.
entries.zh: 节日庆典的成功在很大程度上取决于志愿者。

entries.en: Do not let on that we have already bought the gift.
entries.zh: 不要透露我们已经买了礼物。

entries.en: We searched high and low for the missing key.
entries.zh: 我们到处寻找那把丢失的钥匙。

entries.en: The textbook illustrates several heterocyclic compounds with labeled ring diagrams.
entries.zh: 教材用带标注的环形结构图展示了几种杂环化合物。

entries.en: Students will titrate the solution to determine its concentration.
entries.zh: 学生们将用滴定法测定该溶液的浓度。

entries.en: The researcher presented a psychopharmacological study at the conference.
entries.zh: 研究人员在会议上介绍了一项精神药理学研究。

entries.en: The old scholar remained patient of repeated interruptions.
entries.zh: 那位年老的学者依然能忍受接连的打断。

entries.en: The school of law occupies the building beside the library.
entries.zh: 法学院位于图书馆旁边的那幢楼里。

entries.en: A second is the unit of time used in this table.
entries.zh: 这张表使用的时间单位是秒。

entries.en: The smaller size is out of stock until next week.
entries.zh: 小号已经脱销，要到下周才有货。

entries.en: Her father was still at work when she arrived home.
entries.zh: 她到家时，父亲还在工作。

entries.en: We can work at the algebra problem together after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后我们可以一起解那道代数题。

entries.en: The committee needs to be active throughout the year.
entries.zh: 委员会需要全年都积极开展工作。

entries.en: The lecture contrasted quietism with more active forms of religious devotion.
entries.zh: 讲座将寂静主义与更积极的宗教修行形式作了比较。

entries.en: The textbook explains how the taoiseach is appointed.
entries.zh: 教材解释了爱尔兰总理的任命程序。

entries.en: How did this unexpected change of plan come about?
entries.zh: 这次意外的计划变动是怎么发生的？

entries.en: Please turn on the desk lamp before reading.
entries.zh: 阅读前请打开台灯。

entries.en: The cruise ship will call at three ports this week.
entries.zh: 这艘邮轮本周将停靠三个港口。

entries.en: The coach requested a time out to discuss the final play.
entries.zh: 教练请求暂停比赛，讨论最后一次战术安排。

entries.en: Please be quiet while the guide explains the painting.
entries.zh: 导游讲解这幅画时，请保持安静。

entries.en: I usually go to bed after checking tomorrow's schedule.
entries.zh: 我通常查看完明天的日程后就上床睡觉。

entries.en: Sunlight entered the stairwell through a small lunette.
entries.zh: 阳光透过一扇小弦月窗照进楼梯间。

entries.en: Whether the letter arrived was a question of fact.
entries.zh: 信是否送达是一个事实问题。

entries.en: The argument quickly got out of hand in the crowded room.
entries.zh: 在拥挤的房间里，争论很快失去了控制。

entries.en: The fictional pilot fears he might buy it on the next mission.
entries.zh: 这位虚构的飞行员担心自己可能在下次任务中丧命。

entries.en: Day by day, the repaired garden began to look greener.
entries.zh: 一天又一天，修整后的花园逐渐变得更绿了。

entries.en: This delicate glass bowl is a work of art.
entries.zh: 这只精致的玻璃碗是一件艺术作品。

entries.en: I am out of practice after months without a piano.
entries.zh: 几个月没弹钢琴，我已经生疏了。

entries.en: The archive supplied a photostat of the original letter.
entries.zh: 档案馆提供了原信的一份直接复印件。

entries.en: He kept his baccy in a battered metal tin.
entries.zh: 他把烟草放在一个破旧的金属盒里。

entries.en: The technician inspected the synchro for positioning errors.
entries.zh: 技术员检查了同步机是否有定位误差。

entries.en: People from every walk of life attended the public meeting.
entries.zh: 各行各业的人都参加了这次公众会议。

entries.en: The doorframe is out of true and needs adjusting.
entries.zh: 门框不正，需要调整。

entries.en: Seen end on, the long beam looked surprisingly small.
entries.zh: 从正对端头的方向看，那根长梁显得出奇地小。

entries.en: The treaty formally ended the state of war between the countries.
entries.zh: 这项条约正式结束了两国之间的战争状态。

entries.en: We left the campsite at the break of day.
entries.zh: 破晓时，我们离开了营地。

entries.en: What do the letters on this old badge stand for?
entries.zh: 这枚旧徽章上的字母代表什么？

entries.en: A sudden noise can bring on a round of barking.
entries.zh: 突然的声响会引起一阵犬吠。

entries.en: The checklist includes sanitization of all reusable cups.
entries.zh: 检查表中包括对所有可重复使用杯子的卫生处理。

entries.en: They will typeset the poems in a clear serif font.
entries.zh: 他们将用清晰的衬线字体为这些诗排版。

entries.en: We need to think out the sequence before filming.
entries.zh: 拍摄前，我们需要把顺序想清楚。

entries.en: The dog tried to go after a squirrel.
entries.zh: 那只狗试图追赶一只松鼠。

entries.en: After a good night's sleep, I feel like a million.
entries.zh: 好好睡了一晚后，我觉得精神好极了。

entries.en: Could we meet at some other place tomorrow?
entries.zh: 明天我们能换个地方见面吗？

entries.en: The meeting may run on well past lunchtime.
entries.zh: 会议可能会一直开到午饭时间之后。

entries.en: Rare books sometimes come into the library through donations.
entries.zh: 图书馆有时通过捐赠获得珍本书籍。

entries.en: She played a short tune on the balalaika.
entries.zh: 她用俄罗斯三角琴演奏了一段短曲。

entries.en: A small clock stood on the carved overmantel.
entries.zh: 雕花的壁炉饰架上放着一只小钟。

entries.zh: 他那封辩解信没能解释收据为何遗失。

entries.en: The baker proudly called his bread the staff of life.
entries.zh: 面包师自豪地称自己的面包为生命的支柱。

entries.en: The repair should take two hours at most.
entries.zh: 维修至多应该花两个小时。

entries.en: The door opens only when the green light appears.
entries.zh: 只有当绿灯亮起时，门才会打开。

entries.en: We rested briefly before deciding to move on.
entries.zh: 我们稍作休息后决定继续前进。

entries.en: She plans to write on the history of coastal trade.
entries.zh: 她计划撰文记述沿海贸易的历史。

entries.en: The town's surviving records go back more than three centuries.
entries.zh: 这个镇现存的档案可追溯到三百多年前。

entries.zh: 解剖图展示了大脑周围的各层脑膜。

entries.en: The student identified the astragalus in the ankle model.
entries.zh: 学生在踝关节模型中辨认出了距骨。

entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一瓶密封的旧药剂。

entries.zh: 这节课要求学生辨认每种物质的物态。

entries.en: Nobody should have to go through such a frightening ordeal.
entries.zh: 没有人应该被迫经历如此可怕的磨难。

entries.en: Take an umbrella; it is autumn, after all.
entries.zh: 带把伞吧，毕竟已经是秋天了。

entries.en: We should go over the figures before submitting the report.
entries.zh: 提交报告前，我们应该仔细检查数字。

entries.en: Please book your seat at least a week ahead of time.
entries.zh: 请至少提前一周预订座位。

entries.en: I would not miss her first concert for anything.
entries.zh: 我无论如何也不会错过她的首场音乐会。

entries.en: She stirred the bechamel until the sauce was smooth.
entries.zh: 她搅拌贝夏梅尔白汁，直到酱汁变得细滑。

entries.zh: 这节课用一张简单的电子转移图介绍了氧化还原作用。

entries.en: The ferry traveled to and fro across the narrow channel.
entries.zh: 渡轮在狭窄的水道上来回航行。

entries.en: Her collection of essays will come out next spring.
entries.zh: 她的散文集将于明年春天出版。

entries.en: The essay presents the dispute from a farmer's point of view.
entries.zh: 这篇文章从一位农民的观点呈现了这场争议。

entries.en: The shop sold the remaining chairs at a low price.
entries.zh: 商店把剩下的椅子低价出售了。

entries.en: The file contained proof of service of process.
entries.zh: 卷宗中有传票送达的证明。

entries.en: The exhibition included several black and white photographs of the harbor.
entries.zh: 展览中有几张海港的黑白照片。

entries.en: That homemade soup is not bad at all.
entries.zh: 那道自制的汤确实很不错。

entries.en: The supplies were essential to the sustainment of the isolated community.
entries.zh: 这些物资对维持这个偏远社区的生计至关重要。

entries.meaningZh: 萨巴雍甜酱（一种意大利甜食）

entries.zh: 甜点菜单上有配温热萨巴雍甜酱的新鲜浆果。

entries.en: The tower offers a panoptic view of the entire harbor.
entries.zh: 这座塔可以让人一览整个海港的全景。

entries.zh: 问卷要求业主说明自己从事的行业。

entries.en: Those two have been close friends from way back.
entries.zh: 那两个人从很久以前就是好朋友了。

entries.en: Do not fall for promises of free money.
entries.zh: 不要被免费送钱的承诺骗了。

entries.en: One elected delegate will speak for the whole group.
entries.zh: 一位选出的代表将代表全组发言。

entries.zh: 一大片水域隔开了这两座岛。

entries.en: She hopes to get back her confidence after the setback.
entries.zh: 遭遇挫折后，她希望恢复信心。

entries.en: The display explained how tefillin are worn during morning prayers.
entries.zh: 展陈介绍了晨祷时如何佩戴经文护符匣。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the fluoxetine label against the prescription.
entries.zh: 药剂师对照处方检查了氟西汀的标签。

entries.zh: 他在进入庭院前整理了一下白色腰布。

entries.en: We discovered the faulty wiring early on in the renovation.
entries.zh: 翻修早期，我们就发现了有问题的布线。

entries.en: More often than not, she walks to the station.
entries.zh: 通常，她步行去车站。

entries.en: I will know the departure time for sure tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我明天就能确切知道出发时间了。

entries.en: We need to get through these forms before lunch.
entries.zh: 我们需要在午饭前填完这些表格。

entries.en: He thought he might be sick during the rough crossing.
entries.zh: 渡海时风浪很大，他觉得自己可能会吐。

entries.en: The renovation required quite a little of our savings.
entries.zh: 这次翻修花掉了我们相当多的积蓄。

entries.en: A little towhead was building castles in the sand.
entries.zh: 一个淡黄色头发的小孩在沙地上堆城堡。

entries.en: The botanist examined the sarsaparilla climbing along the fence.
entries.zh: 植物学家检查了沿篱笆攀爬的洋菝葜。

entries.en: The children usually go to sleep soon after their bedtime story.
entries.zh: 孩子们通常听完睡前故事不久就入睡。

entries.en: We need to get over this obstacle before continuing.
entries.zh: 我们需要克服这个障碍，才能继续。

entries.en: The volunteers will give out maps at the entrance.
entries.zh: 志愿者将在入口处分发地图。

entries.en: The contract specifies an hourly rate of pay.
entries.zh: 合同规定了每小时的工资标准。

entries.en: News of the workshop spread mostly by word of mouth.
entries.zh: 有关这次工作坊的消息主要靠口头传播。

entries.en: The poem imagines a people escaping from thralldom.
entries.zh: 这首诗想象了一个民族摆脱奴役的情景。

entries.en: The attendant smiled obsequiously at the wealthy visitor.
entries.zh: 那位服务员对着富有的来客谄媚地微笑。

entries.en: Repeated floods can disjoint sections of the old wooden walkway.
entries.zh: 反复的洪水可能使旧木栈道的各段脱开。

entries.en: He remained true to his wife throughout their marriage.
entries.zh: 在整个婚姻期间，他始终忠于妻子。

entries.en: I get along with everyone in the shared office.
entries.zh: 我和共用办公室里的每个人都相处融洽。

entries.en: The escaped prisoner was still at large that evening.
entries.zh: 那天晚上，越狱的囚犯仍未被捕。

entries.en: We should send for a mechanic to inspect the engine.
entries.zh: 我们应该叫一位机械师来检查发动机。

entries.en: The statement lists the rate of interest beside the balance.
entries.zh: 对账单在余额旁列出了利率。

entries.en: The children all began speaking all at once.
entries.zh: 孩子们全都同时开口说话。

entries.en: The holiday ended all too soon for the children.
entries.zh: 对孩子们来说，假期结束得太快了。

entries.en: Light reflected diffusely from the rough white surface.
entries.zh: 光从粗糙的白色表面向各个方向漫反射。

entries.en: Light waves diffract as they pass through the narrow opening.
entries.zh: 光波穿过狭窄的开口时会发生衍射。

entries.en: The laboratory used epitaxy to grow a thin crystal layer.
entries.zh: 实验室用外延方法生长出一层薄晶体。

entries.en: Arguing about the broken clock was a waste of time.
entries.zh: 争论那只坏钟是浪费时间。

entries.en: For her family, Sunday was a welcome day of rest.
entries.zh: 对她的家人而言，星期日是令人期待的休息日。

entries.en: The villagers had used that path since time out of mind.
entries.zh: 村民们从很久以前就一直使用那条小路。

entries.en: The committee will look into complaints about the building work.
entries.zh: 委员会将调查关于建筑施工的投诉。

entries.en: The lecturer used reward-based learning to illustrate the law of effect.
entries.zh: 讲师用基于奖励的学习来说明效果律。

entries.en: We will spend this night at the inn beside the bridge.
entries.zh: 今天晚上我们将住在桥旁的旅馆。

entries.en: A lone merrymaker was still singing after the party ended.
entries.zh: 派对结束后，还有一个寻欢作乐的人在唱歌。

entries.en: His morning grumpiness faded after the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来后，他早晨的乖戾情绪消退了。

entries.zh: 机械师检查了飞机尾翼是否受损。

entries.en: I have never made pottery, but I will give it a whirl.
entries.zh: 我从没做过陶器，但我会试一下。

entries.en: The application, together with the photographs, arrived this morning.
entries.zh: 申请材料和照片今天早上一起到了。

entries.en: The cottage remained out of sight behind the tall hedge.
entries.zh: 小屋一直被高高的树篱挡住，看不见。

entries.en: The children could see through his unconvincing disguise.
entries.zh: 孩子们能够识破他那不可信的伪装。

entries.en: I remained unengaged all afternoon and could help with packing.
entries.zh: 我整个下午都没事，可以帮忙收拾行李。

entries.en: The stage filled with phantasmagorical images of floating staircases.
entries.zh: 舞台上布满了悬浮楼梯般梦幻的影像。

entries.en: Please carry on with your story after the announcement.
entries.zh: 通知播完后，请继续讲你的故事。

entries.en: The ceremony included a formal welcome from the chief of state.
entries.zh: 仪式包括了国家元首的正式欢迎致辞。

entries.en: The carved bowl is a remarkably fine piece of work.
entries.zh: 这个雕花碗是一件格外精美的作品。

entries.en: The unstable building became a no-go area after the inspection.
entries.zh: 检查后，这幢不稳固的建筑成了禁区。

entries.zh: 河边那座老磨坊不再转动了。

entries.en: I do not care for coffee without milk.
entries.zh: 我不喜欢不加牛奶的咖啡。

entries.en: Her course of study includes history, languages, and archaeology.
entries.zh: 她的学程包括历史、语言和考古学。

entries.zh: 标签在配料中列出了一种无热量甜味剂。

entries.zh: 医学图谱中有一幅展示肠闭锁的图。

entries.zh: 司机们因排班争议宣布按章怠工。

entries.zh: 开车门时，请留神自行车。

entries.zh: 他们的小木屋位于一个偏远的地方。
